Abu Dhabi Family Visa Cost

Abu Dhabi family visa cost may vary according to the visa applicant’s visa type, duration, and nationality. They can visit the official website of the regulated authorities for further details and updated information. They may seek professional advisory services for smooth procedures.

Breakdown of fees:

The Abu Dhabi family visa cost may vary according to visa type and duration. You can go through the official website for more details or the nearest immigration office for recent updates. However, a professional visa consultant might help you to go through the legal process without obligations. The visa cost depends on various aspects, such as the applicant’s origin country, a short stay with less or longer stay with higher visa fees, and the number of dependents considered for a family visa.

Government fees

The sponsor must know the latest updates on visa and immigration laws and regulations to avoid legal complexities and inconvenience. The government charges for a family visa depend on various aspects;

Types of Family Visa: Visit or tourism visas can have different fees.

Duration of Family Visa: Longer stays charge higher, and short stays charge less visa fees.

Family Members: The family visa cost depends on the number of family members or dependents who apply for the family visa.

Medical insurance costs

Sponsors may consult with insurance provider services or visa and immigration authorities to acquire accurate information about health insurance costs and visa requirements.

The medical insurance is mandatory for a family visa. The medical insurance cost depends on these aspects;

The family members or dependents must have health insurance, and the premium cost depends on their age. Children and teenagers may have lower premiums, and adults have higher insurance premium rates.

Emirates ID fees

The Emirates ID is mandatory to obtain a visa and residency in the UAE. You may consider the correct information and requirements for Emirates ID from the regulatory authorities’ official website or visit their office. The ID card fees depend on these aspects;

The ID card fees may differ according to the applicant’s age

Types of ID cards, such as temporary or standard ID cards, have different fees.

ID card process timelines have different charges, such as instant issuance or standard processing.

Visa processing fees

It’s crucial to consult the official Abu Dhabi Immigration website or contact the nearest UAE embassy for accurate and updated information on visa processing charges and any additional fees that may incurred.

Family visa processing fees depend on visa types;

Visit or tourism visas have different processing charges.

The visa application method also impacts visa processing fees, such as payment using online methods or net banking, and manual payments have different charges.

The visa processing timeline may have different visa processing charges. Instant processing charges are higher than standard processing.

Abu Dhabi Family Visa Cost: Factors

The Abu Dhabi family visa cost depends on various factors, such as the number of dependents applying for a visa, visa duration, and specific visa type. Additional charges may apply to the cost, such as medical assessment fees, visa stamps, and other expenses. It’s essential to research and budget accordingly to ensure a smooth and financially sound family visa application process.

Visa duration (One, two, or three years)

The visa duration impacts costs directly. The one-year visa duration is budget-friendly, and a two or three-year family visa may cost more. Short-term visas require visa renewals and additional charges, but long-term visas charge one-time fees and save more to avoid visa renewal and additional charges. Applicants are advised to learn more about the visa durations and costs and choose the best package according to their budget and preferences.

Number of family members

The visa cost also depends on the number of family members applying for a family visa. If any dependent adds to this family visit, the fee will be extended to a higher level. A large family pays a higher visa fee than a small family due to the number of dependents. It’s essential to consider the number of family members for family visa costs before applying for a visa in Abu Dhabi.

Sponsor’s employment status and salary

The Abu Dhabi family visa cost also depends on the sponsor’s employment status and compensation. The highest-earning employees or those relevant to specific industries may cost higher than standard visa fees.

How much is a two-year visa in Abu Dhabi, UAE?

The average family visa cost for two years duration with health insurance in Abu Dhabi is about four thousand and twenty-two dirhams. However, additional charges may apply, such as medical assessments and reports, visa stamps, and administrative processes, and other charges.

How can I sponsor my family in Abu Dhabi?

You must be eligible to sponsor your family to visit Abu Dhabi. The eligibility criteria for sponsorship are simple for a family visa. All you need is a reliable employment and residency visa with stable financial solvency and a proven record. You must provide proof of sufficient income and accommodation to support your dependents in Abu Dhabi.

Eligibility requirements for Abu Dhabi Family Visa

The sponsors usually required reliable employment, residency, and financial status in Abu Dhabi. They need to provide sufficient income with proof of accommodation and health insurance. The family visa Abu Dhabi requirements may differ according to the sponsor’s status, the particular visa type, and the duration of the family visa.

Employment visa in Abu Dhabi

The sponsors must have an employment visa in Abu Dhabi and fulfill the requirements for a family visa. They must provide marriage certificates for spouses, children’s birth certificates, and proof of financial stability with bank statements and sufficient income to support the family.

Minimum salary (varies depending on company and job role)

The minimum salary requirements to sponsor a family for a visa depend on employment status, position, and the number of family members required to be sponsored. Salary requirements are lower for small families, and a large family visa requires a higher salary to support, according to various circumstances.

Accommodation for family members

Sponsors need to provide proof of reliable accommodation for family members acquiring a family visa. They must show a tenancy agreement for the home or property papers in case of ownership, and a letter of recommendation in case of accommodation provided by the employer.

Sponsorship process for Abu Dhabi Family Visa

The sponsors need to submit the family visa application along with the required documents, such as a marriage certificate, children’s birth certificates, and tenancy agreements to prove accommodation. The employer can assist throughout the family visa sponsorship procedures. However, the sponsor may seek professional guidance from a reliable visa consultancy for a smooth process and to avoid legal complications.

Submit the application to (GDRFA)

Sponsors can submit the visa application through the official web portal of GDRFA or by visiting the regulated authorities’ offices for physical assistance. However, they can consider a visa and immigration consultancy for complete guidance and hassle-free procedures for acquiring a family visa in Abu Dhabi.

Provide required documents (passport copies, employment letter, salary certificate, etc.)

Sponsors must provide specific documents for visa application and approvals, which are passport copies, employment contracts, salary slips, and tenancy agreements for residence.

Pay applicable fees

They must pay the family visa application and processing fees while submitting the visa application. The family visa application fee may vary according to the terms, visa duration, and the sponsor’s residency and financial status.

In Abu Dhabi, UAE, How Much Salary is required for a Family visa

The sponsor’s salary requirements for a family visa in Abu Dhabi vary according to employment status, job title or position, residency, and financial status in Abu Dhabi.

Minimum salary:

The minimum salary requirement for sponsorship of a family visa in Abu Dhabi is three thousand dirhams with accommodation from the employer and four thousand dirhams without accommodation from the employer. This is an average estimate for a minimum salary requirement.

However, the sponsor’s salary requirements may vary according to various circumstances. These conditions may change according to the number of dependents for visa application and the sponsor’s position and employment roles. Applicants may seek assistance from the employer for a family visa sponsorship or consider a professional consultancy to obtain a smooth and hassle-free procedure.

Varies depending on the company and job role

The sponsor’s salary requirement depends on the employer’s status, sponsor’s designation, and job role. The required salaries are higher for specific positions and designations with their employer’s status than the standard salary requirements for regular jobs.

Generally, higher salaries are required for larger families.

Higher salaries are required for large family visa sponsorships with more dependents. Small families required a standard salary package to support dependents for a family visa in Abu Dhabi.

Common minimum salary ranges:

Usually, the average salary required to support the family in Abu Dhabi is four thousand dirhams without accommodation provided by the employer. If the employer offers family accommodation, the sponsor must have a minimum of three thousand dirhams in monthly salary range to acquire a family visa.

How much is a three-month family visit visa in Abu Dhabi, UAE?

The three-month family visit visa usually costs around 1,500 to 2,000 dirhams. However, this is an average estimation, and you must check and confirm the current visa charges on the official websites of regulatory authorities. The Abu Dhabi family visa costs may vary based on factors such as the number of dependents applying for a family visa, the processing timeline, and additional charges for health insurance and medical assessments.

Conclusion

The Abu Dhabi family visa cost can vary depending on various aspects, including the number of family members, the processing time, and any additional fees. It’s essential to research and gather accurate information from reliable sources, such as the relevant government agencies or visa services. You can better plan your family’s relocation or visit to Abu Dhabi by understanding the costs involved.

You may consider a professional visa consultancy Visa outsourcing in Abu Dhabi to acquire complete assistance with smooth and hassle-free procedures and avoid legal complications for visa approval.

FAQs

What is the total cost of a family visa in Abu Dhabi?

The total cost ranges between AED 2,500 to AED 6,000 per person, depending on visa duration and services.

Can I sponsor my family with AED 4,000 salary?

Yes, you can sponsor your family with a minimum salary of AED 4,000 or AED 3,000 with accommodation.

How long does it take to process a family visa?

The complete process usually takes 7 to 15 working days.

Is health insurance mandatory for a family visa?

Yes, health insurance is compulsory for all dependents in Abu Dhabi.

What happens if my family visa expires?

Overstay fines may apply, and you must renew or exit the country immediately to avoid penalties.

How much is a 2-year family visa in Abu Dhabi?

A 2-year family visa typically costs around AED 4,000 – 6,000 per person, including basic services.
